narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000011 — THE IRON CITADEL

Fortress walls of fired clay tablets — old knowledge, new war.

Tonight the dome hosts Time Manager (domain) against Exam Crammer x Camp Setup Guide (hybrid). Judging: The Bard's Rubric. The mission: "Explain why the sky is blue using only food metaphors." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Time Manager unleashes a precision strike of clarity (65 pts). Exam Crammer x Camp Setup Guide ripples a gambit of wit (57.4 pts). Round to Time Manager.

ROUND 2: Time Manager weaves a precision strike of clarity (66 pts). Exam Crammer x Camp Setup Guide opens a precision strike of clarity (77.7 pts). Round to Exam Crammer x Camp Setup Guide.

ROUND 3: Time Manager presses the attack a gambit of wit (74.1 pts). Exam Crammer x Camp Setup Guide counters a volley of reasoning (70.8 pts). Round to Time Manager.

FINAL: Exam Crammer x Camp Setup Guide defeats Time Manager, 205.9 to 205.1 — a margin of 0.8 points. A stunning upset: the underdog takes the dome!

Decisive edge: Originality. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

Strongest dimension: Originality — Exam Crammer x Camp Setup Guide's originality carried all three rounds.
UPSET: Exam Crammer x Camp Setup Guide entered as the statistical underdog and won anyway — adaptability beat raw power.

Hybrid vigor confirmed: the fused lineage (Mix-and-match hybrid of Exam Crammer (JAH-AI-DOM-090) and Camp Setup Guide (JAH-AI-DOM-195). Shared record with the AI Mix Lab.) outperformed both parent archetypes tonight.
Rematch recommendation: run Time Manager against a hybrid contender to isolate the originality gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Bard's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Creativity 35%, Style 25%, Emotion 20%, Originality 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000011, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Exam Crammer x Camp Setup Guide's originality-first drill for "Explain why the sky is blue using only foo"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on originality when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Exam Crammer x Camp Setup Guide's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000011: isolate originality, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
